stories.title: NFL suspends Rams LT Jackson two games for punch after Bills game
stories.summary: The NFL on Tuesday suspended Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson for two games without pay after he punched Bills outside linebacker Bradley Chubb following Monday night's game in Los Angeles.

stories.title: Parsons: 'Daniels probably cost my man Dan Quinn his job' with Commanders
stories.summary: Micah Parsons said on his podcast that Jayden Daniels' mistake at the end of overtime Sunday will probably end up getting Commanders coach Dan Quinn fired.

stories.title: Saints' owner rips 1-4 start in public callout, says fans 'deserve better'
stories.summary: Saints owner Gayle Benson called out several members of the organization amid the team's 1-4 start and said that fans are "right to expect more than we have delivered."

stories.title: WNBA moves Finals Games 3, 4 to State Farm Arena to accommodate more fans
stories.summary: The WNBA announced Tuesday that Games 3 and 4 of the Finals between the Golden State Valkyries and Atlanta Dream will be played at State Farm Arena in Atlanta.

stories.title: Sources: Rams release kicker Mevis after miscues in OT loss to Bills
stories.summary: The Rams are releasing kicker Harrison Mevis and signing Blake Grupe off the Jets' practice squad, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo on Tuesday.
